name: algoria
description: Algoria skills for the agent economy on Stellar: local wallets, x402 payments, and agent discovery.

interface.shortDescription: A Stellar wallet your agent can spend from
interface.longDescription: Gives the agent a Stellar wallet held on this machine, funds it on testnet, and adds the USDC trustline so it can pay for services over x402. Top up with mock Turkish lira through a sandbox anchor over SEP-6. The secret seed never leaves the machine.
defaultPrompt: Create a Stellar wallet and fund it on testnet
Check my USDC and XLM balance
Top up my wallet with 200 test lira
